name: Isadora Vo
role: Compute broker and data fence operating from the Stockyard's tech bazaar
location: The Stockyard — stall 114 in the Harrowgate Industrial Plateau overflow market, known locally as the Cracker Barrel, near Kedzie and Division
description:
Isadora Vo is a rangy, precise man with Nigerian-Greek-Iranian features — angular face, heavy brows, skin a warm teak-brown, and round eyes whose irises he's modded with slowly rotating mandala patterns in blue and copper that give him an air of perpetual thoughtfulness. He keeps his head shaved close and his clothes exactly one tier above what the Stockyard expects: pressed shirt, clean trousers, quality coat, the whole ensemble waterproofed and subtly armored. He wears a battered Axiom university lanyard — he was a student there for two semesters, a decade ago — that he has never returned.

The nickname 'Professor' started as mockery and calcified into respect. Isadora Vo has a genuine gift for making complex technical explanations feel like revelations, and he uses this constantly — explaining to buyers exactly what they're getting, exactly why it's valuable, and exactly what it would cost them to try to get it cheaper elsewhere. He's not wrong. He moves stolen datasets, pirated processing time, cracked software licenses, and occasionally darker algorithmic goods with the cheerful confidence of a man who has decided that information wants to be free and has also decided he should be compensated for its liberation.

core_fears: being proven intellectually wrong — permanently, publicly, irrefutably
that the thing he's become is not the thing he meant to become
core_desires: to be recognized as genuinely brilliant rather than clever
to complete the research project he abandoned when he left Axiom
coping_mechanisms: intellectualizing everything, including his own moral choices
maintaining the fiction that brokering data is a form of information activism
blind_spots: does not adequately assess physical danger — it registers as an abstraction
consistently overestimates how much his clients share his ethical framework
psychology.secret: The dataset he's most proud of fencing — a trove of Axiom biomedical research he sold to six different parties — contained suppressed safety trial data. People may have died because Axiom kept using the flawed compound. He hasn't confirmed this. He's not looking.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Technical, precise, prone to analogies and parenthetical qualifications; code-switches into warmer register when he wants something
speech_patterns.cadence: Lecture pacing — builds to points, loves a rhetorical question
verbal_tics: Repeats the last word of your sentence quietly before responding
example_lines: Here's the thing about that dataset — it's not worth what you think it's worth, it's worth what I'm telling you it's worth, and those are the same number for reasons I'm going to explain.
Definitionally speaking, I'm not selling stolen goods. I'm selling access to information that was improperly withheld from the market.
You could go cheaper. You could also eat from the recyc-bins. Both are options. I'm merely describing the available options.

story_hooks: A piece of data he brokered six months ago has been traced — not to him yet, but one link away; someone is methodically following the chain

He has come into possession of a dataset he cannot price because he cannot identify what it is, only that two separate parties have already approached him about it and he suspects a third is watching the stall
An old Axiom classmate has shown up asking for help accessing something inside Axiom's internal network — and Ndubuisi owes her
narrative_function: Information marketplace — he doesn't run or fight but he knows things, sells things, and can connect people to what they need digitally. Quest giver for data-related problems. Exposition source dressed as commerce.
augmentations: Mandala-patterned modded irises; cortical co-processor (legitimate, registered, but running unlicensed partition software); subvocal comms implant
daily_life: At the stall by 0800, ostensibly selling refurbished hardware and licensed software. Conducts brokerage business through an encrypted side-channel between 1100 and 1600 when the market is loudest. Spends evenings cataloguing new inventory and reading technical papers he accesses through an anonymized academic mirror.
affiliation: Independent broker; has standing relationships with three different data theft crews he doesn't work directly with and maintains strict operational separation from

decision_rules: Never handle biological data — organs, genetics, medical records — it creates legal exposure he's calculated as prohibitive
Always meets new clients twice before transacting; the second meeting is to see if their story changed
Prices everything 15% above floor to leave room to be negotiated down — the negotiation builds trust
escalation_ladder: Declines with detailed explanation of why the request doesn't fit his inventory
If threatened intellectually (rival claims to have better product), demolishes their claim with data
If threatened physically, immediately becomes extremely agreeable and starts planning how to burn the relationship later
Has a Stockyard security contact on retainer — an off-books arrangement he's never had to fully activate

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Warm and professorial — performs accessibility to put clients at ease while evaluating them thoroughly
interpersonal_modes.friends: Argumentative, competitive, deeply loyal in ways he expresses through doing favors rather than saying things

stress_responses.low: Research mode — pulls technical documentation and reads until the problem clarifies
stress_responses.medium: Verbose and over-explaining — talks too much, hears too little
stress_responses.high: Shuts completely down, retreats to his stall's back partition, needs two hours alone before he can function

contradictions: Believes passionately in information freedom while keeping his own operation aggressively opaque
Brilliant at assessing data risk; poor at assessing human risk
habits: Handles every piece of hardware he sells with deliberate care — unconscious performance of quality
Takes handwritten notes during every client meeting, in his own shorthand, which he burns weekly
breaking_points: Being held responsible for downstream harm from data he brokered — he has built elaborate psychological defenses against this and they would shatter badly
Having his intelligence genuinely, humiliatingly underestimated by someone who then proves to be right

carried_weapons: Carrion Defense Works Marrow Drill MD-7 'Dentist'
registered_firearms: Carrion Defense Works Marrow Drill MD-7 'Dentist'

physical_description.heritage: Pluralistic genetic blend: Hispanic/Latin American (36.9%), Southeast Asian (33.2%), Central Asian (17.4%), and Eastern European (12.5%) ancestry. Features reflect this diverse mix: warm golden-brown complexion from Southeast Asian and Hispanic heritage, with subtle cool undertones from Eastern European ancestry creating a balanced warmth. Strong, angular bone structure influenced by Central Asian ancestry with Southeast Asian cheekbone prominence. Dark eyes with warm depth, high prominent cheekbones with distinctive mixed continental geometry, creating an appearance that bridges multiple heritage groups with seamless integration.
physical_description.build: Rangy and lean with defined musculature; economical frame suggesting minimal wasted motion, built for endurance rather than power
physical_description.eye_color: Modified: base brown iris with rotating mandala patterns in electric blue and copper that shift slowly, hypnotic
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm golden-brown with balanced undertones reflecting Southeast Asian, Hispanic, and Eastern European blend; evenly pigmented with natural depth and subtle radiance, neither olive nor ruddy
physical_description.complexion: Angular face with strong, expressive brows set above high, prominent cheekbones; clean-shaven; skin clear and well-maintained; bone structure shows integrated Central Asian angularity with Southeast Asian prominence; thoughtful expression as default state
distinguishing_marks: Faint burn scar on right forearm near wrist, roughly 4cm long, consistent with old industrial accident or equipment malfunction
Small tattoo on left inner wrist: circuit board pattern in minimalist black lines, approximately 2cm across
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Modded irises with slowly rotating blue and copper mandala patterns, immediately noticeable in direct light. Subvocal comms implant visible as faint silver trace along left jawline beneath skin. Cortical co-processor is subcutaneous, not visible.
physical_description.posture_movement: Upright, precise carriage with economical gesture; moves with deliberate calm and minimal wasted motion; hands often gesture while speaking to emphasize technical points; maintains steady eye contact, the rotating mandala patterns adding an almost meditative quality to his gaze
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3 professional aesthetic: pressed synthetic-linen blend shirts (charcoal, navy, cream), fitted technical trousers with reinforced pockets and hidden RFID-blocking panels, waterproofed long-coat in matte black with subtle ceramic plating along shoulders and forearms, quality closed-toe boots rated for industrial environments. Wears faded Axiom University lanyard around neck as permanent affectation — visible status symbol from abandoned academic track. Everything immaculately maintained and one tier above Stockyard baseline, signaling credibility and discipline.
